Synthetic ClinPGx-format fixture. The two TSVs copy the column layout of
ClinPGx's `clinicalAnnotations.zip` (`clinical_annotations.tsv`,
`clinical_ann_alleles.tsv`) but every row was written for the test suite:
the annotation IDs, scores and texts are invented (each text says so). The
real bundle is CC BY-SA 4.0 with a no-selling clause and is fetched from
ClinPGx at setup, never redistributed here.
